A sweeping circular driveway and an inviting covered front porch welcome you to this stunning wooded retreat. Step inside to a grand two-story foyer featuring an elegant balcony overlook. The sophisticated floor plan flows seamlessly for entertaining, highlighted by stately pillars that define the formal living and dining rooms. For those working from home or seeking a quiet retreat, the handsome library is appointed with custom cherry wood-built ins.The private backyard operates as your own personal resort. Step out onto the expansive rear deck, complete with a sunken hot tub, and take in the serene views of the heated pool and surrounding mature woods.
